function.name: e2e_risk_assessment
function.description: [EaaS E2E Operating Model — A3.4 Risk Assessment] Identify, score, and allocate the full risk register for an EaaS contract — covering technical, commercial, operational, and strategic risks — with mitigation strategies for each. Outputs: EaaS risk register with scoring matrix; Risk allocation framework (provider vs customer); Mitigation strategy per risk category; Residual risk acceptance criteria.

contract_context.description: EaaS contract description, asset type, and customer

risk_appetite.description: Organisation's risk appetite and any known exposure limits
